hunt.justification: VoidLink is a highly modular, AI-assisted framework designed for enterprise-grade operations. Its ability to create mesh networks allows it to persist and exfiltrate data even from isolated segments, making a proactive hunt for its P2P and proxy behaviors a critical defensive control.

scenario.summary: UAT-9921 leverages the VoidLink framework to compromise technology and financial sectors via Apache Dubbo exploitation and credential abuse. Once established, the modular framework deploys Linux-focused implants with eBPF rootkit capabilities, uses SOCKS proxies for internal network scanning, and maintains communication through a P2P mesh C2 architecture.

meta.rationale: Focus on subnets hosting public-facing web applications or Kubernetes clusters, as these are the primary initial access targets.
meta.hypothesis: Adversaries are using compromised Linux servers to host SOCKS gateways and mesh peer-to-peer C2 nodes, enabling internal reconnaissance and stealthy exfiltration.

hunt.name: VoidLink Lateral Scanning and Mesh-Network C2
hunt.description: VoidLink is a modular framework (UAT-9921) that specifically targets Linux environments. This hunt identifies the 'defense-contractor grade' network capabilities of the implant: specifically its use of SOCKS proxies for internal scanning (FSCAN behavior), and its peer-to-peer (P2P) mesh routing that allows compromised hosts to act as gateways for isolated internal nodes. We look for high-volume internal-to-internal connections, rare listeners on common proxy ports, and anomalous outbound traffic volumes originating from the internal mesh.

config.content: SELECT hostname AS device_hostname, platform, os_name, ip_address, time FROM hb_devices WHERE (LOWER(platform) IN ('linux', 'ubuntu', 'debian', 'centos', 'redhat') OR LOWER(os_name) LIKE '%linux%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify active Linux assets to provide context for the hunt's target operating system.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames. Absence of Linux hosts suggests this hunt is not applicable to the environment.

primitive_config.label: Linux Server Scoping
primitive_config.content: SELECT hostname AS device_hostname, platform, os_name, ip_address, time FROM hb_devices WHERE (LOWER(platform) IN ('linux', 'ubuntu', 'debian', 'centos', 'redhat') OR LOWER(os_name) LIKE '%linux%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames. Absence of Linux hosts suggests this hunt is not applicable to the environment.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dst_endpoint_ip) AS unique_targets, COUNT(*) AS connection_attempts, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '192.168.%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name HAVING unique_targets > 20 ORDER BY unique_targets DESC
config.description: Find processes reaching out to many internal targets, a hallmark of the FSCAN tool used by UAT-9921.
config.expected_signal: One or more hosts where a process is touching an unusually high number of internal IPs. Legitimate scanners should be filtered by the analyst.

primitive_config.label: Internal Scanning Behavior (FSCAN)
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dst_endpoint_ip) AS unique_targets, COUNT(*) AS connection_attempts, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '192.168.%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name HAVING unique_targets > 20 ORDER BY unique_targets DESC
primitive_config.expected: One or more hosts where a process is touching an unusually high number of internal IPs. Legitimate scanners should be filtered by the analyst.

config.content: SELECT process_name, port, process_cmd_line, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_network_listener WHERE instr(',' || '{{socks_ports}}' || ',', ',' || CAST(port AS TEXT) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_name, port, process_cmd_line HAVING total_instances <= 3 ORDER BY total_instances ASC
config.description: Identify unusual processes listening on common SOCKS ports. VoidLink's implants are often custom compiled.
config.expected_signal: A rare process name or command line associated with a standard SOCKS port. Absence of host info in this surface requires correlation by process name in triage.

primitive_config.label: Rare SOCKS/C2 Listeners
primitive_config.content: SELECT process_name, port, process_cmd_line, COUNT(*) AS total_instances, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_network_listener WHERE instr(',' || '{{socks_ports}}' || ',', ',' || CAST(port AS TEXT) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_name, port, process_cmd_line HAVING total_instances <= 3 ORDER BY total_instances ASC
primitive_config.expected: A rare process name or command line associated with a standard SOCKS port. Absence of host info in this surface requires correlation by process name in triage.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, SUM(traffic_bytes) AS total_bytes, COUNT(*) AS connections FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (src_endpoint_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_endpoint_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_endpoint_ip LIKE '192.168.%') AND (dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '192.168.%') AND dst_endpoint_port NOT IN (22, 80, 443, 8080) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port HAVING connections > 100 ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
config.description: Detect high-volume internal-to-internal traffic on non-standard ports that may indicate the VoidLink P2P mesh.
config.expected_signal: Persistent, high-volume internal connections on unusual ports. This could indicate a data relay or mesh control plane.

primitive_config.label: Internal Mesh P2P Routing
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, SUM(traffic_bytes) AS total_bytes, COUNT(*) AS connections FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (src_endpoint_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_endpoint_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_endpoint_ip LIKE '192.168.%') AND (dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '192.168.%') AND dst_endpoint_port NOT IN (22, 80, 443, 8080) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port HAVING connections > 100 ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
primitive_config.expected: Persistent, high-volume internal connections on unusual ports. This could indicate a data relay or mesh control plane.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, SUM(traffic_bytes) AS total_out_bytes, COUNT(DISTINCT dst_endpoint_port) AS ports_used FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND direction = 'outbound' AND NOT (dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '192.168.%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip ORDER BY total_out_bytes DESC LIMIT 20
config.description: Identify potential exit points for the mesh network by tracking high-volume outbound data to external IPs.
config.expected_signal: The top 20 hosts/destinations by data volume. Correlate with 'mesh-p2p-routing' to see if data flows from internal mesh to external exit.

primitive_config.label: Anomalous Egress Volume
